{{Top}}
'''Arconese''' was the official language of [[Cona/Legends|Cona]] and the native language of the local species, the [[Arcona/Legends|Arcona]]. However, those Arcona born and raised in colonies outside of Cona did not usually learn Arconese, but the local language instead.
